description.zh-CN: 长期记忆管理与上下文摘要，定期将叙事历史压缩为滚动摘要，确保长时间会话不丢失关键上下文。
description.en-US: Long-term memory management and context summarization. Periodically compresses narrative history into rolling summaries, ensuring long sessions retain critical context.

schema.description: Update the rolling memory archive with a merged summary. Call this with the combined summary of old archive + new narrative.

summary.description: The updated rolling summary text (300-500 words, third person, past tense)

schema.description: Record a significant event for long-term storage. Call 0-3 times per summarization for important plot points.

content.description: A single sentence describing the key event and why it matters
